## 1) Chart type
A **composite visualization** combining:
- **Two horizontal bar charts** at the top
- **One tabular heatmap / highlighted table** at the bottom

## 2) Layout techniques
- Uses a **multi-panel layout**:
  - Left panel: horizontal bars by **state**
  - Right panel: horizontal bars by **age at entry**
  - Bottom panel: **table** of occupations with two numeric columns
- No stacking is used.
- No faceting in the strict repeated-scale sense, but it functions as **separate panels/small sections** for different variables.
- Color highlighting is used to emphasize selected values/cells.

## 3) Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| State | Categorical/nominal | Row position / y-position in left horizontal bar chart; text label |
| DACA beneficiaries | Quantitative | Bar length in left chart; numeric label inside/near bars |
| Age at entry | Ordinal (discrete numeric categories shown as ages 0–15) | Row position / y-position in right horizontal bar chart; text label |
| Percent of DACA beneficiaries | Quantitative | Bar length in right chart; numeric label inside/near bars |
| Occupation | Categorical/nominal | Row position in bottom table; text label |
| DACA-eligible workers | Quantitative | Numeric text in left numeric column of table; cell background highlight/color intensity |
| DACA-ineligible workers | Quantitative | Numeric text in right numeric column of table; cell background highlight/color intensity |
| Highlight/emphasis status | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue (yellow vs blue in bars; shaded cells in table) |
